facts.business: Zensar Technologies Limited is a leading international provider of technology solutions, specializing in design, data engineering, advanced analytics, cloud transformation, digital experience platforms, and AI-led services for industries including Telecommunications, Media and Technology, Banking Financial Services and Insurance, Manufacturing and Consumer Services, and Healthcare and Life Sciences.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company remains committed to becoming an AI-native technology services Company, with nearly 85% of its workforce trained in AI.

auditor.name: S R B C & CO LLP

key_risks: Telecommunications, Media and Technology (TMT) segment faced headwinds during FY26
facts.related_party_note: All transactions entered into by the Company with related parties were in the ordinary course of business and at arm's length basis. The Audit Committee grants omnibus approval for transactions in the ordinary course of business.
